snippet.title: The Taj Mahal Cost Him His Hands #TajMahal #Shorts
snippet.description:
A dramatic paper-diorama retelling of the legend of Ahmad, the architect placed in charge of building the Taj Mahal—and the brutal price that followed his greatest achievement.

A short story about skill, power, and what happens when being irreplaceable becomes dangerous.

requested.title: The Taj Mahal Legend: Why the Architect Lost His Hands #TajMahal #Shorts
requested.description:
One legend about the Taj Mahal tells of Ahmad, the architect placed in charge of its construction—and the terrible price he and his assistants paid after the monument was finished.

This short retells a story about skill, power and a ruler who feared that its creator might build something just as magnificent again. The tale is presented as a legend, not an established account of what happened to the builders.
